items.text: Robert Pullen-Miles is the mayor of Lawndale, first elected in 2014 after serving on the city council from 2004 to 2014. He was district director for Assemblymember Autumn Burke and earlier a staffer for state senators.

sentences.text: Robert Pullen-Miles is the mayor of Lawndale, first elected in 2014 after serving on the city council from 2004 to 2014.
He was district director for Assemblymember Autumn Burke and earlier a staffer for state senators.

items.text: His 2022 campaign outlined plans to increase the number of deputy sheriffs and support juvenile diversion programs. His campaign says he initiated an amnesty program for unpermitted properties and a home improvement rebate program.

items.text: In 2020, he defended the city's decision to block a homeless housing project at a hotel, saying other communities were more suitable. He supported the Hawthorne Boulevard route for the Metro C Line extension.
